reviews.review: I like how each stage has its own colour and the screens stay clean; spikes, lasers and the goal door are easy to read. First Steps and Spike Garden feel fair, the spikes sit in plain view. Saw Mill is where I would quit: saws float everywhere at stage three, even the skilled player died, and more than half the ghosts are dead. Ferry Lines kills near the goal with a saw that arrives late, which feels cheap. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are fun. Spring Loaded is pretty but nearly risk-free. Gauntlet mixes everything and feels like a proper finale.
reviews.best: Laser Gate: clear beams, visible timing, deaths that look like my own fault.
reviews.worst: Saw Mill is a hard wall at stage three with floating saws that are tough to judge.

reviews.review: The curve is upside down in the middle. Saw Mill is stage 3 but it is the hardest: all three recorded players die, and it throws four floating saws at jump height with no safe first saw to learn from. Ferry Lines hides its only saw at 80%, after the ferries, which reads as a gotcha. Then Spring Loaded at stage 6 has almost no risk; nobody dies on its long spike bed. I like Laser Gate: dotted beams telegraph the timing and deaths look earned. Gauntlet mixes every mechanic fairly. First Steps kills two of three players, which is harsh for a tutorial.
reviews.best: Laser Gate teaches its timing with clear telegraphed beams before it adds spikes and a saw.
reviews.worst: Saw Mill tests a saw swarm at stage 3 before it teaches one saw, and even the high-skill player dies.

reviews.review: The curve is out of order. Saw Mill at stage 3 kills more than half the field and all three recorded players, including the high-skill one; the saws hang in mid-air at jump height and the deaths are spread along the whole upper deck, so it looks like timing luck, not a line I can learn. Ferry Lines hides its only saw at 80%, after ten seconds of waiting on platforms. Spring Loaded is a free stage: 92 of 100 finish and the one saw is far above the route. Spike Garden, Crumble Bridge, Laser Gate and Gauntlet are tight, readable and fast.
reviews.best: Gauntlet mixes all the mechanics in 14 seconds and each death there has a clear cause.
reviews.worst: Saw Mill is harder than the final stage and Spring Loaded, three stages later, has almost no risk.

git.subject: v7: revert the failed stage 6 change from v6; third balance pass
git.body:
Measurement (v6): stage 6 pass 8/500 (1.6%), 491 timeouts at tiles 26-27.
The v6 change "spikes after pad 3: 5 -> 6 tiles" was wrong. I used the
paper number for the pad flight (218 px). Measured flight from the pad:
the player comes down 6.1-6.5 tiles after the pad tile, on the 6th spike,
from each start position. Reverted to 5 spikes. The new saw from v6 stays
(it was reached by 9 bots only, so its effect is not yet measured).
Other v6 results, mid-skill pass: stage 1 86.7% (too easy), stage 3 59.3%,
stage 4 52.7% (too hard).
- stage 1: 20 timeouts at tile 53 (4 tiles of run between a gap and 2
  spikes): run 4 -> 6 tiles. Harder: gaps at tiles 16 and 67 3 -> 4 tiles,
  spikes at tile 53 2 -> 3.
- stage 3: 30 deaths at the two bobbing saws: period 150 -> 170.
- stage 4: 40 pit deaths between the twin ferries: second ferry 3 -> 4
  tiles wide. 36 pit deaths at the end of the last ferry line: it stopped
  0.5 tile short of the ground; travel 6 -> 6.5 tiles.
